name: superpowers
description: Core skills library for ZCode: brainstorming first, red/green TDD, systematic debugging, subagent-driven development and skill authoring. Upstream obra/superpowers (MIT), repackaged because the upstream SessionStart hook depends on an executable bit that a ZCode install does not carry.

description_i18n.en: Core skills library for ZCode: brainstorming first, red/green TDD, systematic debugging, subagent-driven development and skill authoring.
description_i18n.zh-CN: ZCode 版技能核心库：头脑风暴先行、红绿 TDD、系统化调试、子代理驱动开发与技能编写（上游 obra/superpowers，MIT）。因上游 SessionStart hook 依赖可执行位、而 ZCode 安装不保留该位，故重新打包。
